text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm taking a stroll through a park on my
day off,
when...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: HI-YAH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I come across Yaeno Muteki practicing
martial
arts.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
You're from the academy... Yes, this
training is
my daily routine.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
However, my skills still pale in
comparison to
either of my masters...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I thought I could apply the ancient
martial arts
I've studied to racing as
well... I believed that if I
ran fast, I could
also punch faster...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I entered the academy for this reason,
but doing
so only opened my eyes to
just how far I have yet
to go.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
My grandparents. They're masters of the
Kongo
Yaegaki style.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
What can I possibly do to come closer to
reaching
their level?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...I see. I shall concentrate my efforts on

increasing the speed of my strikes, then.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I will try it at once... HAH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whoosh!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Hm. Concentrating on the speed of my
punches
has made me realize I need to
improve my form.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I feel as though I am once again a
novice, seeing
things for the first time! I
shall continue this
exercise for a little
longer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki stoically continues
practicing her
punches.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...I see. I shall concentrate my efforts on

increasing the strength of my strikes,
then.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I will try it at once... HAH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wham!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Hm. Concentrating on the force of my
punches
has made me realize how much
energy each strike
consumes.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
However, that is exactly the point of
training. I
feel all the more motivated to
continue now!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki stoically continues
practicing her
punches.
